name: Cebu
tagline: Island Paradise Where Your Dollar Goes the Furthest in Asia
description: Cebu is the Philippines' most livable island city — a thriving metro surrounded by world-class diving, pristine beaches, and turquoise waters, where English is spoken natively and the cost of living is astonishingly low. The SRRV retirement visa makes long-term residency straightforward, the healthcare system is strong and affordable, and the Filipino warmth creates one of the most welcoming expat communities in Asia. For FIRE retirees who want tropical island living without sacrificing connectivity or English-language comfort, Cebu is hard to beat.

quickFacts.visa: Special Resident Retiree's Visa (SRRV), restructured September 2025: minimum age 40; SRRV Classic deposit $30,000 (age 50+) or $50,000 (age 40–49) without a qualifying pension, reduced to $15,000 / $25,000 with a lifetime pension of $800+/month; the former SRRV Smile/Human Touch tiers were abolished. Renewable, includes multiple-entry privileges.
quickFacts.language: Filipino/Cebuano (English is an official language and widely spoken)
quickFacts.internetSpeed: 30-100 Mbps (fiber available in metro areas, improving rapidly)
quickFacts.safetyRating: Moderate — generally safe in expat and business areas, standard urban awareness in downtown, avoid isolated areas at night
quickFacts.nearestAirport: Mactan-Cebu International Airport (CEB) — 30 min from Cebu City, direct flights to major Asian hubs
quickFacts.climate: Tropical maritime with warm temperatures year-round (26-33°C). Dry season Jan-May, wet season Jun-Dec. Occasional typhoons.

housing.description: Modern 1BR in or just off IT Park / Cebu Business Park, pool + gym + 24/7 security

dining.description: Local Filipino eateries and fresh-seafood BBQ, occasional Western

healthcare.description: Individual international/regional plan (local HMOs cap older expats)

1M.lifestyle: A modern one-bedroom condo in or just off IT Park or Cebu Business Park, with pool, gym, and 24/7 security. Eating leans on local Filipino eateries and fresh-seafood BBQ, with Grab and jeepney for getting around and an international/regional health plan covering Cebu Doctors and Chong Hua. English is spoken natively, which makes daily life easy, and weekend island-hopping is cheap. Comfortable, though city traffic is heavy and electricity bills run high on a hot island.

housing.description: Spacious 2-bedroom condo in a premium development like Ayala or Solinea with resort-style amenities, or beachfront unit on Mactan Island

dining.description: Mix of local Filipino food, Japanese, Korean, and Western restaurants, regular fresh seafood feasts, waterfront dining on Mactan

healthcare.description: Comprehensive private insurance with access to top Cebu hospitals, dental, annual check-ups, and prescription coverage

transportation.description: Regular Grab rides, rented scooter for Mactan exploration, occasional domestic flights to Palawan or Siargao

entertainment.description: Scuba diving certification and regular dive trips, island-hopping charters, spa days, beach club memberships, Sinulog festival VIP access

2M.lifestyle: A comfortable unit in a premium development or a beachfront condo on Mactan, dining out regularly across Filipino, Japanese, Korean, and Western spots. Grab plus a rented scooter for Mactan, a comprehensive international plan with dental, and dive trips to Moalboal and Malapascua. Cheap domestic flights open up Palawan and Siargao. Life is social, easy, and strong value. (Interpolated tier.)

housing.description: Nice beachfront unit on Mactan or a premium Business Park high-rise with views

dining.description: Cebu's best restaurants and regular seafood feasts

healthcare.description: Mid international plan, medical travel to Singapore/Bangkok if needed

transportation.description: Leased car with driver for traffic, domestic flights, boat transfers

entertainment.description: Dive packages, boat charters, golf at Alta Vista, spa

3M.lifestyle: A nice beachfront unit on Mactan or a premium Business Park high-rise with views, dining at Cebu's best and regular seafood feasts. A leased car with a driver for the traffic, domestic flights and boat transfers for island exploration, and a mid international plan. A genuinely affluent island routine, with diving and beaches always close.

housing.description: Stunning beachfront compound on Mactan or exclusive resort-style villa with private pool, tropical gardens, and direct ocean access

dining.description: Private chef for daily meals, fine dining as routine, curated wine collection, legendary Filipino-fusion feast hosting

healthcare.description: International concierge medicine, private physician, wellness retreats, anti-aging treatments, fly-to-Singapore coverage for specialized care

transportation.description: Luxury vehicle with full-time driver, private boat for island-hopping, domestic charter flights, regular international travel

entertainment.description: Private yacht charters, exclusive dive expeditions, golf memberships, art collecting, philanthropic projects supporting local communities

domesticHelp.description: Full-time housekeeper, cook, gardener, driver, and part-time nanny or personal assistant

luxuryExtras.description: Private Cebuano language tutor, personal trainer, bespoke island exploration planning, marine conservation involvement, premium club memberships

5M.lifestyle: A large beachfront property on Mactan with pool, gardens, and ocean access, staffed by a housekeeper, cook, gardener, and driver. A private boat for island-hopping the Visayas, business-class regional flights, and premium international health cover. This budget stretches a long way, though Cebu's medical and cultural depth stays below Manila's. (Interpolated tier.)

housing.description: Large oceanfront estate on Mactan with private beach and dock

dining.description: Fine dining as available plus a private chef sometimes

healthcare.description: Global VIP cover with fly-anywhere specialist access

transportation.description: Luxury vehicle plus drivers, domestic flights, a boat

domesticHelp.description: Housekeeper, occasional cook, groundskeeper, and driver for the residence (PH help is cheap)

luxuryExtras.description: Luxury travel, marine conservation, bespoke experiences

10M.lifestyle: A large oceanfront estate on Mactan with private beach and dock, run by a housekeeper, an occasional cook, groundskeepers, and a driver. Full concierge international health cover with fly-anywhere specialist access, fine dining as available, first-class international travel, and a boat for the Visayan Sea. This is far more than Cebu's market can absorb — the ceiling is set by limited luxury infrastructure, occasional typhoons, and the distance from major Asian hubs.
